title: 从出院记录到患者理解：基于人格的LLM出院教育者开放式模拟
summary: 提出DischargeBench，一个基于人格的模拟框架，让LLM教育者与虚拟患者进行多轮出院教育对话，并由教育监控Agent维持患者真实性。基于MIMIC-IV构建477个案例，从对话质量、主题清单、理解度和事实一致性四方面评估，发现聚合分数掩盖了不同患者人格下的临床相关差异。
summary_en: Introduces DischargeBench, a persona-grounded simulation where an LLM educator conducts multi-turn discharge education with a Virtual Patient, regulated by an Education Monitor Agent. Built on 477 MIMIC-IV cases across 24 ICD chapters, it scores Conversation Quality, Topic Checklist, Comprehension, and Factual Consistency, revealing that aggregate scores mask clinically relevant variation across patient personas.
